meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 读取你给的 Figma 设计文件，提取里面的页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例和设计令牌，整理成一张可交互浏览的设计知识图谱，并自动打开仪表盘展示，同时给出各类节点和关系的统计摘要。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Figma 文件的 URL 或文件 key 并请求分析时触发；需要预先设置 FIGMA_TOKEN 环境变量。

say.text: 分析这个Figma设计稿，生成知识图谱
say.note: 需在对话中附上Figma链接或文件key。

say.text: 梳理Figma里用到的设计令牌和组件
say.note: 设计令牌和组件会作为图谱节点提取。

howto.what_en: Reads the given Figma design file, extracts pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, and design tokens, then produces an interactive design knowledge graph rendered in a dashboard, with summary stats for node types and relationships.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a Figma file URL or file key and asks for analysis; the FIGMA_TOKEN environment variable must already be set.

say_en.text: Analyze this Figma file and build a knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Attach a Figma link or file key in the conversation.

say_en.text: Analyze this Figma file in English.
List the design tokens and components used in this Figma.
say_en.note: Tokens and components are extracted as graph nodes.
